metadata.author: June 27, 2004 - Don't Take My Advice by Brendan Emmett Quigley, edited by Fred Piscop

entries.clue: They say patience is a virtue, but ...
They say nice guys finish last, but ...
They say absence makes the heart grow fonder, but ...
They say time waits for no man, but ...
They say strike while the iron is hot, but ...
They say a penny saved is a penny earned, but ...
